item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. An intense winter monsoon will reach the coast of southern China on Christmas Day. The weather will become cold appreciably, and it will be windy with a few rain patches over the region early next week. The monsoon is expected to moderate gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week, the weather will be generally fine over the coast of Guangdong, it will remain cool in the morning.
